what: Fetch and unpack the source of cranelift-object 0.137.1 (the newest; 01151 brought cranelift-object 0.137.0 and the rest of the family at 0.137.1). Every other cranelift crate 0.137.1 has the same src as 0.137.0, so the family stays =0.137.0 (vendor/cranelift-codegen, vendor/cranelift-object) until cranelift-object 0.137.1 shows whether the point release changes anything blaze builds.

history.note: crates.io cranelift-object 0.137.0 (sha256 78f98e6d6b502fa1..., matches SOURCE.md) and 0.137.1 (sha256 c38304b64d440315...): src/ is byte-identical; Cargo.toml differs only in its own version and the four cranelift dependency versions (0.137.0 -> 0.137.1). The point release changes nothing blaze builds, so the family can move to =0.137.1 by renumbering the two vendored manifests and the pins, with no source change. Unpacked at /tmp/clo.
